value.rationale: Identifies a sharp structural breakdown of a previously established nonadaptive escape-optimality principle at the first nontrivial larger cylinder depth, and proves it survives in the exponential growth rate, not merely a small finite-horizon exception. The paired exact polynomials give reusable benchmarks for the unresolved optimizing-schedule phase diagram. The sharp five-observation boundary and Perron comparison are a single motivated dynamical claim, not arbitrary table recomputation.
